horn.use: The player's car horn: loop while the horn button is held (use the .ogg for gapless looping).

melt-fizz.use: A robot melting into a rust heap (slumping -> heap).

moat-jingle.use: Moat Labs four-note jingle (A4 D5 E5 B4): bad robots hum it (tell, subtlety 3).

robotaxi-horn.use: A robotaxi's polite double chirp when it honks (agent mode honk).

rust-creak.use: A joint rusting solid: rust past 0.5, seize and slump.

splash.use: Water lands on a robot or the pavement.

spray.use: Blaster stream loop: play while firing; loops seamlessly (use the .ogg for gapless looping).
